name: laser-tag-spot
description: 8s neon laser tag commercial built with Remotion

scripts.render:reel: remotion render src/index.ts LucioleReel out/luciole-reel-raw.mp4 && npm run master:reel
scripts.master:reel: ffmpeg -v error -y -i out/luciole-reel-raw.mp4 -c:v copy -af loudnorm=I=-14:TP=-1:LRA=9 -c:a aac -b:a 192k -ar 48000 -movflags +faststart out/luciole-reel.mp4
